description: Monthly European natural gas reference price in USD per MMBtu (World Bank series PNGASEUUSDM, via FRED). Not the Dutch TTF hub settlement, day-ahead or storage level; the route name is kept for the owner. Latest value plus up to 24 months of history. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_ttf_european_gas
title: Energy Ttf European Gas
